🇵🇰 The Asian Games have officially begun! Nagoya, 🇯🇵Japan lit up tonight as athletes from across the continent marched into the stadium for the 2026 opening ceremony and Pakistan proudly stood among them, the flag held high. There's something different about watching it happen in person rather than on a screen. Thousands of athletes, 45 nations, one stadium, one shared moment. The ceremony brought together centuries of Japanese tradition with a level of production that honestly left everyone in awe.💫 But beyond the lights and the spectacle, moments like these remind us why we compete in the first place. Not just for medals, not just for records but for the honor of carrying our flag on Asia's biggest stage, representing every person back home who's cheering us on.✨ The Games have started. The real work begins now. 🇵🇰💚 #pakistanzindabad🇵🇰 #teampakistan #asiangames2026 #nagoya2026 #aichinagoya2026

lessed and proud moment 🇵🇰 Representing Pakistan as Captain of the National Soft Tennis Team at the 2025 Nonghyup Bank Incheon Korea Cup was an honor beyond words. Stepping onto that court wearing the green and white — it's a feeling that stays with you forever. Grateful for every match, every teammate, and every moment of this journey. Another long day in Anseong but honestly one of the best so far 🇵🇰 Started with the ceremony, then had some downtime by the lake 🌊 which was such a nice break from the courts. Walked around the city a bit on my own, saw the Lotte World Tower up close (it's massive lol), then back for dinner with the boys 🍽️ before an intense match in the evening 🎾 Days like this remind you why you put in the work. Proud to be out here repping Pakistan 💚 #teampakistan #softtennis #anseongkorea #worldsofttennischampionship #pakistanzindabad #tennislife

🇵🇰 Still processing this one. Got to represent Pakistan as Captain of our National Soft Tennis Team at the 17th Anseong World Soft Tennis Championships 2024. 🎾 Played doubles alongside the team, went up against some really strong fixtures, and just being out there with the flag on my back is something I won't forget anytime soon. 💚🤍 Huge respect to the whole team. This was a group effort start to finish. 📍 Anseong Matchum Soft Tennis Stadium, South Korea 🗓️ 1st – 11th September 2024 #pakistanzindabad #teampakistan #softtennis #anseong #worldchampionship
